listenings.text: Hey, quick voice message about last night. We played four matches. I know, it was late. We won the first two, and the second one was really close. Then we lost the third one, because I made a bad call at the end. My fault. The last one, we beat them nine to two. Nine to two! My score was the best of the week. After that I practiced the new map for an hour. Text me when you wake up.

Okay, that is a wrap for tonight. Here is the quick recap. I started this stream with zero wins, and I finished with six. Six! I lost the first two matches, and I was not happy about it. Then something changed. I stopped rushing, I played slower, and I won five in a row. That is my best score of the season. Thanks for watching, and same time tomorrow.
